estimates: The model covers the R42 building on the Solbosch campus and its immediate entrances. The other university buildings occupy separate locations.
The underlying mapped perimeter and both entrances are exact horizontal controls. Eave height, west canopy edge and opening, copper panel spacing, and individual façade dimensions are interpreted.

Terrain samples establish the rising grade between entrances as a geographic preview. The broad 12 m site relief also extends off the building footprint. Interior furnishings and signage are simplified.

review.notes: Reviewed both published Qualla candidates first. The photographers dedicated their photos under CC0. The 2010 architecture has separate rights and its public-place exception has use conditions. Written primary architectural facts and native data serve as model sources.
